# The bridge generation

A copy of the development catalogue generation the KalaReach plugins repository publishes, held
here so the catalogue's plugin methods are tested against a release a real pipeline signed that
carries a native bridge recipe: the Claude Code package 0.3.0.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Source | `kalareach-plugins`, `snapshots/development/` |
| Commit | `d7e8dbe3007553783b58398d26d31474baf015d3` |
| Metadata valid to | 2036-09-22 |

The copy is the whole generation, byte for byte, apart from this file. The signing keys' private
halves are not in it. It changes only by a deliberate re-copy from a named commit, with the commit
above changed in the same change; no test regenerates it.
